PATIENT SIGNATURE: _____________________________________________________ DATE SIGNED:____________________________



 ***THIS AUTHORIZATION EXPIRES 90 DAYS AFTER IT IS SIGNED

I hereby consent to medical treatment and procedures performed by the healthcare providers at Contemporary Health Center.

I acknowledge that:

1. TREATMENT INFORMATION: My healthcare provider has explained my condition, the recommended treatment, potential benefits, risks, and alternative options.

2. NO GUARANTEES: I understand that the practice of medicine is not an exact science and that no guarantees have been made regarding the outcome of treatments or procedures.

3. QUESTIONS: I have been given the opportunity to ask questions and all my questions have been answered satisfactorily.

4. CHANGES IN TREATMENT: I understand that during the course of treatment, unforeseen conditions may necessitate additional or different procedures than originally planned.

5. MEDICAL HISTORY: I have provided accurate and complete information about my medical history, current medications, and allergies.

6. FOLLOW-UP CARE: I agree to follow all instructions provided and attend all recommended follow-up appointments.

7. FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY: I understand that I am financially responsible for all charges related to my care.

By signing below, I acknowledge that I have read, understand, and agree to this consent form.

I understand that hormone replacement therapy (HRT) is a medical treatment designed to supplement or replace hormones that my body no longer produces in adequate amounts. I have been informed of the potential benefits, risks, and alternatives to this treatment.

Potential Benefits:
- Relief from symptoms of hormonal imbalance
- Improved energy and mood
- Enhanced quality of life
- Better bone density
- Improved sexual function

Potential Risks:
- Blood clots
- Stroke
- Heart disease
- Breast cancer (in some cases)
- Mood changes
- Weight gain
- Acne or skin reactions

I understand that:
- Regular monitoring and blood tests are required
- Individual results may vary
- Treatment may need to be adjusted over time
- I should report any side effects immediately
- I can discontinue treatment at any time

I have had the opportunity to ask questions and have received satisfactory answers. I consent to hormone replacement therapy as prescribed by my healthcare provider.

I consent to undergo laser treatment as recommended by my healthcare provider. I understand the nature of the procedure, its purpose, and potential outcomes.

Procedure Description:
The laser treatment uses focused light energy to treat the designated area. The procedure may cause temporary discomfort, redness, or swelling.

Potential Benefits:
- Improved skin texture and appearance
- Enhanced function of treated area
- Non-invasive or minimally invasive treatment
- Little to no downtime

Potential Risks and Complications:
- Temporary redness, swelling, or bruising
- Skin discoloration (hyperpigmentation or hypopigmentation)
- Scarring (rare)
- Burns or blisters
- Infection
- Unsatisfactory results requiring additional treatments

I agree to:
- Follow all pre-treatment and post-treatment instructions
- Disclose all medications and medical conditions
- Attend all follow-up appointments
- Report any unusual symptoms immediately

I understand that results may vary and multiple treatments may be necessary for optimal outcomes. I have been given the opportunity to ask questions and all my questions have been answered to my satisfaction.

NOTICE OF PRIVACY PRACTICES ACKNOWLEDGMENT

Contemporary Health Center is committed to protecting your health information. This notice describes how medical information about you may be used and disclosed and how you can access this information.

YOUR RIGHTS:
- Right to inspect and copy your health information
- Right to request amendments to your health record
- Right to request restrictions on uses and disclosures
- Right to request confidential communications
- Right to receive an accounting of disclosures
- Right to a paper copy of this notice

OUR RESPONSIBILITIES:
- We are required by law to maintain the privacy of your health information
- We will notify you if a breach occurs that may have compromised your information
- We will not use or share your information except as described in this notice

HOW WE MAY USE YOUR INFORMATION:
- For treatment purposes
- For payment purposes
- For healthcare operations
- As required by law
- For public health and safety
- With your written authorization for other purposes

You have the right to file a complaint if you believe your privacy rights have been violated. Complaints should be submitted in writing to our Privacy Officer.

For a complete copy of our Privacy Practices, please request one at the front desk or visit our website.

I acknowledge that I have received the Notice of Privacy Practices.

CONSENT FOR MEDICAL TREATMENT

I, the undersigned, hereby consent to medical treatment and procedures as deemed necessary by the healthcare providers at this medical practice.

I understand that:

1. The practice of medicine is not an exact science and I acknowledge that no guarantees have been made to me regarding the results of treatments or examinations.

2. I consent to the performance of medical procedures, treatments, and diagnostic tests as ordered by my physician or healthcare provider.

3. I understand that my medical records may be reviewed by other healthcare professionals involved in my care.

4. I have the right to refuse any treatment, medication, or procedure, and to be informed of the medical consequences of such refusal.

5. I understand that I may revoke this consent at any time by notifying my healthcare provider in writing.

6. I have been given the opportunity to ask questions about my treatment and those questions have been answered to my satisfaction.

7. I consent to the administration of medications, anesthetics, and other treatments as prescribed.

8. In case of emergency, I authorize the healthcare providers to provide such treatment as may be necessary to preserve my life and health.

By signing below, I acknowledge that I have read and understood this consent form and have had the opportunity to ask questions.

I voluntarily consent to medical treatment at this facility.

HORMONE REPLACEMENT THERAPY (HRT) INFORMED CONSENT

I, the undersigned, hereby consent to receive Hormone Replacement Therapy as prescribed by my healthcare provider.

I understand that HRT involves:
• Administration of hormones (estrogen, progesterone, testosterone, or combinations thereof)
• Regular monitoring through blood tests and clinical evaluations
• Potential need for dosage adjustments

BENEFITS OF HRT:
My healthcare provider has explained that potential benefits may include:
• Relief from menopausal symptoms (hot flashes, night sweats, mood changes)
• Improved bone density
• Enhanced sexual function and libido
• Improved energy and overall quality of life
• Better sleep quality

RISKS AND SIDE EFFECTS:
I understand that HRT may involve the following risks:
• Blood clots (deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism)
• Increased risk of certain cancers with long-term use
• Cardiovascular events (stroke, heart attack)
• Gallbladder disease
• Breast tenderness
• Mood changes
• Weight changes
• Headaches
• Nausea

CONTRAINDICATIONS:
I have disclosed to my healthcare provider any history of:
• Blood clots or clotting disorders
• Breast cancer or estrogen-dependent cancers
• Liver disease
• Undiagnosed vaginal bleeding
• Heart disease or stroke
• Pregnancy or breastfeeding

ALTERNATIVES:
I understand that alternatives to HRT include:
• Lifestyle modifications (diet, exercise, stress management)
• Non-hormonal medications
• Complementary therapies
• No treatment

MONITORING:
I agree to:
• Regular follow-up appointments
• Periodic blood tests as recommended
• Annual physical examinations
• Mammograms and other cancer screenings as appropriate
• Report any concerning symptoms immediately

I acknowledge that:
• HRT is not appropriate for everyone
• Individual response to HRT varies
• Treatment may need to be adjusted or discontinued
• I may stop treatment at any time by notifying my provider
• The long-term effects of bioidentical hormones are not fully known

By signing below, I certify that:
• I have read and understand this consent form
• My questions have been answered
• I voluntarily consent to HRT treatment
• I will follow all treatment recommendations
